system.description:
[Female] only. When your [Armor Slot] is empty, your [Physical Defense] and [Magic Defense] becomes [CR + (DEX Mod)].

(SR 2): When you have only a single [One-Handed] [Katana] equipped to a [Hand Slot], your [Attack Power] and [Magical Power] becomes [Attack Power of Weapon x 2], and add the [Magic Stone] tag to [Katana].

A fighting style that manipulates the sword with a light movement like a petal dancing in a whirlwind. Your determination and will dwell in the sword you wield, giving you the power to destroy your enemies.
